subject.title: feat(android): in-chat model picker with favorites and recents

question: Should Android fresh connects request full `operator.admin` for model switching in this PR, or should model switching wait for a narrower gateway permission?
rationale: `sessions.patch` currently requires `operator.admin`, but adding that scope to Android broadens device-token authority and affects upgrade behavior for already paired devices, so automation cannot choose the permanent security contract.

options.title: Approve admin parity after fixes
options.body: Accept the iOS-parity admin request for this Android feature, but require the correctness fixes and real Android proof before merge.

options.title: Split a narrower permission
options.body: Keep this PR paused while gateway adds a model-only session patch permission and Android uses that narrower contract.

options.title: Defer Android model switching
options.body: Close or pause the feature until the mobile model-selection security contract is settled elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Approve admin parity after fixes
recommendation.body: Accept the iOS-parity admin request for this Android feature, but require the correctness fixes and real Android proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The parent issue and recent mobile chat work point to steipete as the best available owner for the product/security scope decision.
